Candidates are advised to read the notification carefully and refer "How to Apply" & "FAQ" pages on the main page. Application submitted through Online form does not imply that candidate has fulfilled all the criteria given in the notification. Application is subject to subsequent scrutiny and can be rejected if found to be ineligible at any point of time. Support and Best Viewed on Internet Explorer 9+; Google Chrome 30+ ; Firefox 20+ This Website is viewable only in Landscape Mode.

items.title: OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 Out at osssc.gov.in, Download OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF
items.doc_text:
Exams » OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 The Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission has released the OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 for the CRE-2025 written examination, marking an important update in the OSSSC Result 2026. Along with the result, the commission has also released the OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF, containing the provisional list of candidates shortlisted for the next stage. Candidates can check their marks by logging in to the official website, osssc.gov.in. Those who find their roll numbers in the merit list will be eligible to appear for the Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills. OSSSC CRE Merit List 2026 PDF and Result Link: Download Here The marks of each candidate are shown only after login, so there is no separate scorecard PDF. The merit list PDF, on the other hand, can be opened by anyone and checked for roll numbers. Both links are given below. OSSSC Result 2026: RI ARI AMIN Important Links OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 (Login) Check Result OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF (Screening List) Download PDF RI & ARI Result 2026 OUT! Share your selection details in this form for next-stage guidance & felicitation 👉 Click Here OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 Out: Notice The official notice covers two things: the written test result and the list of candidates shortlisted for the skill test. It applies to all seven posts under CRE-2025, from Revenue Inspector to Statistical Field Surveyor. The date of the skill test is not part of this notice and will be shared later. OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 Out: Overview Here are the main details of the OSSSC RI ARI Result and the merit list in one place. OSSSC RI ARI Result 2026 Out: Key Highlights Commission Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) Exam Combined Recruitment Examination (CRE-2025) Posts RI, ARI, Amin, ICDS Supervisor, VAW, Junior Assistant and SFS Written Test Held 22 May to 28 June 2026 Result Date 20 November 2026 Merit List Format PDF (Annexure-I, roll numbers only) How to See Marks Candidate logs in with User ID and Password Result Stays Online For 60 days Next Round Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills Skill Test Date To be announced Website osssc.gov.in OSSSC CRE-2025 Important Dates The CRE-2025 process has moved from the written test to the result stage. The table below shows where things stand right now. Event Date Written Test 22 May to 28 June 2026 Result and Merit List 20 November 2026 Practical Skill Test To be announced Document Verification To be announced OSSSC Result 2026: Post-wise Status Check CRE-2025 is a combined exam, so a single OSSSC Result 2026 has been issued for all the posts below. The way to check the result is the same for every post, and your post-wise status will be shown when you log in. Post Result Mode Next Stage Revenue Inspector (RI) Login + Merit List Skill Test Assistant Revenue Inspector (ARI) Login + Merit List Skill Test Amin Login + Merit List Skill Test ICDS Supervisor Login + Merit List Skill Test Village Agricultural Worker (VAW) Login + Merit List Skill Test Junior Assistant Login + Merit List Skill Test Statistical Field Surveyor (SFS) Login + Merit List Skill Test How to Check OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 Marks? Your OSSSC RI ARI Result is linked to your candidate account. You don’t need to visit any office for it. Keep your User ID and Password ready and follow these steps. Go to osssc.gov.in. Click on the candidate login option on the home page. Type your User ID and Password, then log in. From your dashboard, open the Result / Marks section. Pick the CRE-2025 written test result. Your marks and screening status will open on the screen. Take a screenshot or print it, as the result will be removed from the portal after 60 days. How to Find Your Roll Number in OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF? You don’t need to log in for this. The merit list is a simple PDF of roll numbers, so a quick search is enough. Open the OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF from the link given above. Scroll to Annexure-I. Keep your written test admit card handy for your roll number. Press Ctrl + F on a computer, or use “Find in page” on mobile, and type your roll number. If it shows up, you have been shortlisted for the skill test. Save the PDF on your phone or computer for later use. Details Mentioned in OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 Once your result is released, go through every detail carefully. If anything looks wrong, contact the commission at the earliest. Name of the examination (CRE-2025) Recruitment advertisement number Candidate’s name and roll number Post name Marks obtained in the written test Screening status for the skill test Details of the next selection stage What Does the OSSSC CRE Merit List Mean for You? The merit list only tells you who moves to the next round. It is not the final selection list, and there are a few things every candidate should keep in mind. Your name on the list means you can appear in the Practical Skill Test. The list is provisional, so it can still change as per the commission’s rules. Some candidates have been screened only for the VAW and Junior Assistant posts, so check your post-wise status after logging in. If your roll number is not in the list, you have not been shortlisted in this round. Roll Number Not in OSSSC CRE Merit List? What to Do Not finding your roll number can be disappointing, but first make sure you have checked properly. A small mistake while searching is more common than you think. Search the PDF again using the exact roll number printed on your admit card. Log in to your account and check your screening status there as well. If you still find a mismatch, contact OSSSC with your roll number and registration details. If you were not shortlisted, keep your preparation going for the upcoming OSSSC exams. OSSSC Practical Skill Test 2026: What to Expect The skill test checks how comfortable you are with a computer. It is a qualifying round, which means you only need to clear it, and its marks are not added to your merit. Only candidates on the merit list can take this test. Candidates need at least 40% marks to qualify. The date, venue, and admit card details will be shared on osssc.gov.in. Start practising typing, MS Word, MS Excel and basic internet use from now. How to Prepare for OSSSC Practical Skill Test 2026? Since the test is about basic computer skills, regular hands-on practice matters more than theory. Spend at least an hour a day on a computer until the test date is announced. Practise typing daily to improve both speed and accuracy. Learn basic MS Word tasks like formatting text, making tables and saving files. Learn simple MS Excel work like entering data, using basic formulas and sorting. Get comfortable with sending emails, searching the internet and handling files and folders. Follow a structured course, such as the Adda247 Skill Test Batch , for guided practice. OSSSC CRE-2025 Selection Process After Result The written test is done, but the journey is not over yet. Here is how the remaining process will move forward. Written Test: Completed. The result is out. Practical Skill Test: For candidates on the merit list. Qualifying in nature. Document Verification: Based on merit and vacancies. Date not out yet. Post and District Choice: Where needed, as per OSSSC notice. Date not out yet. Tips for Candidates After OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 A little planning now can save you trouble later. Keep these points in mind while you wait for the skill test notice. Check your result only on osssc.gov.in and avoid unofficial websites. Do not share your login details with anyone. Save your marks before the 60-day window ends. Keep your original certificates for age, qualification and category ready for verification. Visit the OSSSC website regularly for the skill test schedule. FAQs on OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 Q1. Is the OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 out? Ans. Yes, OSSSC released the result for the CRE-2025 written test on 20 November 2026. Q2. Where can I download the OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF? Ans. The OSSSC CRE Merit List PDF is given in the important links table above. The shortlisted roll numbers are listed in Annexure-I of the result notice. Q3. Does the OSSSC CRE Merit List show marks? Ans. No, the merit list has roll numbers only. To see your marks, you need to log in to your candidate account. Q4. How long will the OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026 stay online? Ans. The result will be available on the OSSSC portal for 60 days. Q5. What is the next stage after the OSSSC CRE-2025 result? Ans. Shortlisted candidates will take the Practical Skill Test in Basic Computer Skills, which is qualifying in nature. Q6. What are the qualifying marks in the OSSSC Practical Skill Test? Ans. Candidates need at least 40% marks to qualify the skill test. Q7. Is the OSSSC CRE Merit List the final selection list? Ans. No, it is a provisional list for the skill test. Final selection will depend on the remaining stages. Q8. How can I check the OSSSC Result 2026 for RI ARI posts? Ans. Log in on osssc.gov.in with your User ID and Password and open the Result / Marks section to see your OSSSC RI ARI Result. Q9. Which posts are included in the OSSSC RI ARI AMIN Result 2026? Ans. The result covers RI, ARI, Amin, ICDS Supervisor, VAW, Junior Assistant and Statistical Field Surveyor posts under CRE-2025. Q10. When will the OSSSC Practical Skill Test 2026 be held? Ans. OSSSC has not announced the date yet. It will be shared through a separate notice on osssc.gov.in. Q11. What happens after the OSSSC Practical Skill Test? Ans. Candidates who qualify the skill test will be called for document verification based on merit and available vacancies. Q12. Is there a separate result for ICDS Supervisor and SFS posts? Ans. No, all seven posts under CRE-2025 share the same result. ICDS Supervisor and SFS candidates can check their marks through the same login.
